system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Medicine and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Botany Lore, Animal Anatomy Lore, Lore of a particular ecosystem.
system.description: You studied living things in the places they grew and hunted, preserving specimens and comparing your observations. You learned to recognize signs of injury or illness that a casual observer would miss.
